title: ITIL4 Training
lead: Training programme preparing participants for the ITIL4 Foundation certification — the globally recognised entry-level ITSM qualification.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The ITIL4 training programme covers the key concepts, practices and principles of ITIL4. It prepares participants for the ITIL4 Foundation exam, which is the entry point to the broader ITIL4 certification scheme. The training combines theory, worked examples and practice exams.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: ITIL4 training is used in ITOM engagements to build a common language and baseline knowledge across the IT organisation. It is particularly valuable at the start of ITSM-focused operating model redesigns, ensuring all stakeholders share the same understanding of service management concepts.
